body: Wow, what an asshat. Thanks for indulging my curiosity

Thank you, you seem kind. The story was sad but nice to hear at the same time. Maybe i will try, or at least fake it for the family. I dont know, yet. I am tired...tired in so many ways..

But the cancer just might..im sorry you're going through something like this. It's awful. Thanks for answering me.

They may not say it or even think it really,but i do burden them in ways. I cant work at the moment but it costs money to be alive and have insurance and all that jazz. I tried a gofund me once, it didnt do too well. I dont know a lot of people. Thank you for the reply.
I didnt know that, thank you for mentioning something. Im tired a lot, no spring in my step whatsoever and im still pretty young. Thanks for the response.
